rationale: Builds on the 1.5111 staged reverse-tail recurrent-tail best while fixing the last marker failures by keeping MAX_WALLCLOCK_SECONDS, VAL_LOSS_EVERY, and final_int8_zlib_roundtrip_exact literal in the submitted train_gpt_mlx.py. The patch keeps the model/export/final-eval path intact but leaves MLX_EAGER_EVAL enabled by default on the single-microbatch path so loss and gradient tensors are materialized before optimizer updates, targeting the recent MLX 0.29 step-51 lazy-work cliff without changing data or tokenizer resolution.
title: Eager Single-Batch Flush Endgame Guard
